title: Cajun {p} & {v} with Rice
steps: Soften the {v} with the {spice} in a heavy pot with a little oil.

Add the {p}, brown any sausage or pork first, the {sauce} and enough water or stock to cover. Dried red kidney beans need soaking, then a hard boil of at least 10 minutes, first; canned beans only need draining.
Simmer 30 to 45 minutes, mashing some beans against the pot to thicken, until any meat is at least 165°F / 74°C inside.
tip: Use more beans than sausage and plenty of celery and peppers to keep it lighter and less salty.
